cases.comment: Fresh break address, breaker 1 (Art 23.1; the break_spot option pends, Art 23.1(c)).
Fresh break address, breaker 2 (the seat-ball law keys off the breaker, Art 23.2/23.4).
Seat 1 (starter) scores with the plain white (Art 23.2; Art 83 three cushions; Art 24.4 continue).
Seat 2 scores with ITS ball (ball 1) — per-seat cue assignment (Art 22.1/23.4).
Seat 2 strikes the starter's white: 'wrong ball' foul (Art 41.11); the cannon is void, turn passes.
Seat 1 strikes the opponent's ball: 'wrong ball' (Art 41.11).
Breaker 2 owns the plain white (Art 23.2): seat 2 striking ball 0 is legal under the swapped assignment.
Breaker 2: seat 1 owns ball 1, striking ball 0 is the Art 41.11 foul.
Cannon with zero prior cushions: FOUL announced 'no cushion' (Art 83 letter).
Cannon with one prior cushion: FOUL announced 'one cushion' (Art 83).
Cannon with two prior cushions: FOUL announced 'two cushions' (Art 83).
Second ball never contacted: the legal Art 24.5 miss — the Art 83 foul binds 'before touching the second object-ball', not the failure to reach it.
A jumped ball (Art 41.1) precedes the Art 83 announce; only the ball concerned respots (Art 28.1(b) -> 27.3(b)).
Break phase, first contact on the white: wrong-first-ball-break (Art 23.3/41.12) — v1 law carried.
equal_innings OFF: the breaker's target point ends the match at once (Art 29.1/29.2).
Judge with the break-spot option pending refuses (adapter contract, Art 23.1(c)).
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"decision-pending","message":"carom3c-v2: judge called while the break-spot option is pending (Art 23.1(c)) — resolve it via applyDecision"}}

cases.comment: break_spot choice 1 = LEFT start spot (Art 23.1(c)).
Only decision 10 exists in carom.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-decision","message":"carom3c-v2: unknown decision id 9 (only 10 carom_break_spot — UMB Art 23.1(c) — and 16 contact_respot — UMB Art 27.1(a))"}}

cases.comment: break_spot with no pending option refuses.
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"bad-decision","message":"carom3c-v2: decision 'break_spot' does not match the pending option (none)"}}

cases.comment: The v1 hud projection (stage rename, no variant block) holds for v2.
Config-in-state is mandatory: a v2 state without the variant block is invalid-task-config, never a default fallback (contracts/registry-api.md §3).
cases.expect: {"error":{"code":"invalid-task-config","message":"carom3c-v2 state: missing 'variant' block (config-in-state, contracts/registry-api.md §3 — never a default fallback)"}}
